descriptions.text: Coffee Shop Author Kit. Alcoholism and crippling self-doubt not included. So you want to be a writer. It started with sappy poetry in middle school. You soon graduated to Naruto fanfiction. … Anyway, this is a magical sheet of paper. You will find you now have a second tab on your scratchpad in your interface. You can write something on this paper, and it will appear in the scratchpad and vice versa. If the proper spell and glyphs are accurately copied onto this paper, you can present the sheet at a market kiosk, and a scroll will appear for sale. …

recap.text: Carl's Gold Makeup Sex is the Best Sex box holds a sheet of paper, a quill pen and a jar of black ink, and Mordecai tells him to sell the set. The pen copies Carl's Does this work? and his rudimentary cat portrait. Carl then clips the paper to the bathroom stall wall with a magnet from the Juicer's boss room. Katia has just put the quill back to pass on coordinates when Louis barges in.

Carl adds a note to the Cookbook, 25th edition, saying he is starting something he does not think will succeed and, as Drakea asked of future authors, means to document every step. He points readers to his earlier post on the coffee shop author's kit, where the crew's hidden way of talking is explained. He pastes in page one: the party is a trap, Queen Imogen is a country boss, goal one is to survive.

beats.headline: Paper from a strange box
beats.text: Carl's Gold Makeup Sex is the Best Sex box holds a sheet of paper, a quill pen and a little capped jar of black ink. Odd, says Mordecai: pricey, used by scholar and arcanist classes for scroll production, and Carl's best bet is to sell the set. The description gives Carl a second scratchpad tab, which panics him, because the cookbook already hides one, but he simply has three now. He writes Does this work? and the pen rises, dips and copies it, then copies his rudimentary cat portrait. Am I a joke to you, Carl? Cool and completely useless, says Carl.
beats.gist: Carl's paper, quill and ink hold a pen that copies his writing and his cat portrait.

beats.headline: A haunted bathroom
beats.text: The stall in the personal space bathroom is the only place the crew can trade messages without anybody seeing. A dry-erase marker on the metal kept getting wiped by the cleaner bot, so Carl clipped the magical paper to the wall with a magnet from the Juicer's boss room; Katia writes with the pen, it appears in his scratchpad, and he answers at once. Donut tried it once, writing with her mouth: I AM NOT USING THIS, CARL. Katia took it all down when the refugees arrived, but has just put the quill and paper back to pass on coordinates when Louis barges in. You didn't tell me your bathroom was haunted!
beats.gist: Carl clips magical paper in the stall so Katia's writing appears in his scratchpad.

beats.headline: The plan, written down
beats.text: Carl adds a note to the Cookbook, 25th edition. He is starting something he does not think will succeed, and as Drakea asked of future authors, he means to document every step. The crew has a way of talking that prying eyes cannot see, and he points readers to his earlier post on the coffee shop author's kit to see how it works. Then he pastes in page one of their notes. The party is a trap. Queen Imogen is a country boss. Goal one is to survive.
beats.gist: Carl adds a Cookbook note: the party is a trap, Imogen a country boss, survival goal one.
